reason: I have one apartment next to my house and the guests can knock on my door. Paying €150 plus €35 a month to a new little company I never heard of, for something that talks to my guests for me, is too much of a risk for what I earn from it.
objection: If this company closes next year or the robot tells my German guests something wrong about check-out or parking, it is my reviews that suffer, not theirs. I don't know these people.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour or someone from the tourist board I trust using it for a whole summer and telling me it saved them time, and no setup fee so I lose nothing if it fails.
